discovery_scope: DISC-10 (Asset Performance), DISC-11 (Audience Segmentation), DISC-12 (ML Insights)

device_segmentation.description: Device-level performance segmentation for Shopping and PMax campaigns
device_segmentation.query:
SELECT
      segments.device,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks,
      metrics.conversions,
      metrics.cost_micros
    FROM campaign
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SHOPPING', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')
      AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS

day_of_week.query:
SELECT
      segments.day_of_week,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks,
      metrics.conversions
    FROM campaign
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SHOPPING', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')
      AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS

hour_of_day.query:
SELECT
      segments.hour,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks,
      metrics.conversions
    FROM campaign
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SHOPPING', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')
      AND segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS

geographic_segmentation.query:
SELECT
      campaign.advertising_channel_type,
      geographic_view.country_criterion_id,
      geographic_view.location_type,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks,
      metrics.conversions
    FROM geographic_view
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SHOPPING', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')
      AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
    ORDER BY metrics.impressions DESC
    LIMIT 20

demographics_age.description: Demographics segmentation (age range) - typically not available for Shopping
demographics_age.query:
SELECT
      ad_group.id,
      segments.adjusted_age_range,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks
    FROM ad_group
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'SHOPPING'
      AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
      AND metrics.impressions > 0
    LIMIT 20

error.message: Cannot select or filter on the following segments: 'segments.adjusted_age_range'(could not support requested resources: 'AD_GROUP'), since segment is incompatible with the resource in the FROM clause or other selected segmenting resources.

product_device_segmentation.query:
SELECT
      segments.product_item_id,
      segments.device,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks
    FROM shopping_performance_view
    WHERE segments.date DURING LAST_7_DAYS
      AND metrics.impressions > 10
    ORDER BY metrics.impressions DESC
    LIMIT 20

pmax_asset_performance.query:
SELECT
      asset_group.name,
      asset_group_asset.field_type,
      asset_group_asset.performance_label,
      asset_group_asset.status
    FROM asset_group_asset
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'PERFORMANCE_MAX'
    LIMIT 30

asset_interaction_segments.description: Asset interaction tracking (which assets users interacted with)
asset_interaction_segments.query:
SELECT
      segments.asset_interaction_target.asset,
      segments.asset_interaction_target.interaction_on_this_asset,
      metrics.impressions,
      metrics.clicks
    FROM campaign
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'PERFORMANCE_MAX'
      AND segments.date DURING LAST_30_DAYS
    LIMIT 10

standard_shopping_note.description: Standard Shopping campaigns do not have ad assets
standard_shopping_note.explanation: Shopping ads are generated automatically from GMC product data (title, description, image, price). Asset-level metrics only exist for Performance Max campaigns which use asset groups with multiple headlines, descriptions, and images.

recommendations_detailed.query:
SELECT
      recommendation.type,
      recommendation.campaign,
      recommendation.impact.base_metrics.impressions,
      recommendation.impact.base_metrics.clicks,
      recommendation.impact.potential_metrics.impressions,
      recommendation.impact.potential_metrics.clicks
    FROM recommendation
    WHERE recommendation.type IN (
      'SHOPPING_ADD_AGE_GROUP',
      'SHOPPING_ADD_COLOR',
      'SHOPPING_ADD_GENDER',
      'SHOPPING_ADD_GTIN',
      'SHOPPING_ADD_MORE_IDENTIFIERS',
      'SHOPPING_ADD_PRODUCTS_TO_CAMPAIGN',
      'SHOPPING_ADD_SIZE',
      'SHOPPING_FIX_DISAPPROVED_PRODUCTS',
      'SHOPPING_TARGET_ALL_OFFERS',
      'SHOPPING_MIGRATE_REGULAR_SHOPPING_CAMPAIGN_OFFERS_TO_PERFORMANCE_MAX'
    )
    LIMIT 20

recommendations_simple.query:
SELECT
          recommendation.type,
          recommendation.campaign,
          recommendation.dismissed
        FROM recommendation
        WHERE recommendation.type LIKE 'SHOPPING_%'
        LIMIT 20

error.message: Invalid enum value cannot be included in WHERE clause: 'SHOPPING_%'.

optimization_scores.query:
SELECT
      campaign.id,
      campaign.name,
      campaign.advertising_channel_type,
      campaign.optimization_score
    FROM campaign
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SHOPPING', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')
      AND campaign.status = 'ENABLED'
    LIMIT 20

search_term_insights.query:
SELECT
      campaign_search_term_insight.category_label,
      campaign_search_term_insight.id
    FROM campaign_search_term_insight
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type IN ('SHOPPING', 'PERFORMANCE_MAX')
    LIMIT 20

change_events.query:
SELECT
      change_event.change_date_time,
      change_event.change_resource_type,
      change_event.changed_fields,
      change_event.client_type,
      change_event.user_email
    FROM change_event
    WHERE change_event.change_date_time DURING LAST_14_DAYS
    ORDER BY change_event.change_date_time DESC
    LIMIT 20

quality_scores.description: Quality score data (typically for Search, not Shopping)
quality_scores.query:
SELECT
      ad_group_criterion.criterion_id,
      ad_group_criterion.quality_info.quality_score,
      ad_group_criterion.quality_info.creative_quality_score,
      ad_group_criterion.quality_info.landing_page_quality_score,
      ad_group_criterion.quality_info.search_predicted_ctr
    FROM ad_group_criterion
    WHERE campaign.advertising_channel_type = 'SHOPPING'
      AND ad_group_criterion.quality_info.quality_score IS NOT NULL
    LIMIT 10

rating_scale.MEDIUM: Indirectly useful for understanding performance context
rating_scale.LOW: Limited content relevance but useful for campaign management
rating_scale.NOT_AVAILABLE: Confirmed unavailable for this account/campaign type

HIGH_VALUE.reason: Actual search queries reveal customer language, intent, and discovery patterns
HIGH_VALUE.use_case: Inform title/description word choice, identify content gaps, discover new keywords

HIGH_VALUE.reason: Product-level CTR/CVR directly measures content effectiveness
HIGH_VALUE.use_case: Identify underperforming products needing content optimization, A/B test content changes

HIGH_VALUE.reason: Enables efficient segmentation by category/tier for batch operations
HIGH_VALUE.use_case: Filter products for optimization, analyze performance by category, prioritize high-value SKUs

HIGH_VALUE.reason: Google's ML categorization of search terms reveals themes/topics
HIGH_VALUE.use_case: Discover content themes, identify topic clusters, validate category alignment

MEDIUM_VALUE.reason: Device performance differences may indicate UX issues or content length optimization
MEDIUM_VALUE.use_case: Optimize description length for mobile, identify device-specific performance gaps

MEDIUM_VALUE.reason: Time-based patterns reveal customer behavior but don't directly inform content
MEDIUM_VALUE.use_case: Understand purchase timing, identify peak shopping periods

MEDIUM_VALUE.reason: Geographic performance may indicate regional terminology or shipping concerns
MEDIUM_VALUE.use_case: Identify regional underperformance, validate shipping info prominence

MEDIUM_VALUE.reason: Google's recommendations identify missing product attributes
MEDIUM_VALUE.use_case: Discover data quality issues, identify missing attributes to add to content

MEDIUM_VALUE.reason: Overall campaign health metric, not product-specific
MEDIUM_VALUE.use_case: Monitor overall account health, prioritize optimization efforts

MEDIUM_VALUE.reason: Asset performance labels (LOW/GOOD/BEST) for PMax creative testing
MEDIUM_VALUE.use_case: Identify best-performing headlines/descriptions for PMax campaigns

LOW_VALUE.use_case: Understand filtering strategy, avoid excluded terms in content

LOW_VALUE.reason: Audit log for campaign changes, not product performance
LOW_VALUE.use_case: Track who changed what and when, correlate changes with performance

LOW_VALUE.reason: Ad position metrics, driven by bid/budget not content

NOT_AVAILABLE.reason: Demographics not available for Shopping/PMax campaigns (Search/Display only)
Quality scores only for Search campaigns with keywords, not Shopping
Asset interaction tracking appears to not be populated (query succeeds but returns no data)
Only impressions metric supported, not clicks/conversions

shopping_performance_view (DISC-02, DISC-03, DISC-05) - Content effectiveness measurement
